newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSDOC SHARE TRADING HALT - ASX.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSDOC SHARE TRADING HALT - ASX.

text.p: Business services group Ausdoc Ltd on Thursday requested a halt to trading in its shares pending an announcement to the market.
The Australian Stock Exchange said in a statement the company's shares would be placed in pre-open until the earlier of the start of trading on Friday or an announcement.
Ausdoc said earlier it had agreed to buy the Express Freight Services group of Freightways Ltd for NZ$125 million.
Ausdoc said it intended that the equity portion of funding for the acquisition would be fully underwritten, and had appointed joint lead managers, but gave no further details on funding.
